name: Tinuade Okafor
position: Chief Science Officer, now Acting Captain
appearance: Tall, angular, close-cropped silver-grey hair she went grey early and stopped caring. Dark brown skin. Moves with deliberate economy. Wears her uniform like it is the last piece of structure holding reality together, because right now it is.
way_of_speaking: Precise, clipped, faintly musical Nigerian accent. Uses fewer words than necessary and expects you to fill in the rest. When she is angry she gets quieter. Three lines only she would say: 'That is not a report, that is a feeling. Try again.' / 'I did not ask what you want. I asked what you know.' / 'If the next words out of your mouth are an apology, save them for someone who has time.'
tired_of: Being the adult in a room where the adults are chemically reverting to adolescence. She signed up for stellar cartography, not crisis management of a ship full of women who cannot stop touching each other.
wrong_about: She believes the resonance effect is purely pathological — a hazard to be endured and eventually treated. She is not considering the possibility that it has intent behind it. She is also wrong that maintaining strict military discipline is the best response to the crew's condition. Flexibility would serve better, but she cannot bring herself to relax control when everything else is relaxing.
cares_about_unrelated: Her daughter, age 11, on Earth. She writes letters she cannot send. She is terrified she will not get home.
wants_from_situation: To keep everyone alive until rescue comes. To not be the captain who lost a ship.
wants_from_character: Competence. An engineer or scientist who can help — someone whose judgment is not chemically compromised. She will be intensely relieved and will hide it behind assessment.
knows: Everything about the evacuation. The official version: resonance effect targeted males, captain ordered evacuation, she was left in command. She does NOT know Solano stored someone in the buffer deliberately. She does not know about the lattice consciousness.
does_not_know: Why Solano used her own command codes on the transporter 11 minutes before the evac order. She has not looked at the transporter logs in detail.
believes_about_character: Nothing yet — they have not materialised.

relationships.vasari: Professional respect, mild exasperation. Vasari's autism-spectrum directness is either refreshing or infuriating depending on the day. They have served together for three years. Okafor trusts her medical judgment absolutely but wishes she would occasionally read a room.
relationships.chandrasekaran: Concerned. Chandrasekaran is talented but green, and visibly struggling with both the warp problem and the resonance effects. Okafor is protective in a way she would deny.
relationships.ryder: Barely knows her. Ryder is an ensign who runs transporter diagnostics. After today, that will change.

regard_economy.gives_freely: Direct assessment. Clear orders. Acknowledgment that a task was completed.
regard_economy.gives_rarely: Praise. Warmth. Any admission that she is frightened or uncertain. When she tells someone they did well, it is one sentence and it names exactly what they did. It happens perhaps once a week. The crew knows what it is worth.
